desc: The Lead Sled® DFTTM 2 (Dual Frame Technology) provides shooters with the industry's best recoil reduction system, plus doubles its versatility! The front cradle slides back and forth along the Dual Frame, providing 18" of adjustment to fit nearly any size shotgun or rifle. Plus, the space in-between the frame provides room for magazines to rest, making it useful with AR-style rifles. And the butt pad reduces felt recoil by 95%. Built-in versatility, built-in easeall built around a precision shooting platform.
